C1262.title: GPS Spoofing: Detecting GPS Fraud in Unmanned Aerial Vehicles
C1262.summary: This study examines how adversaries exploit GPS spoofing attacks against drones by forging GPS signals to mislead onboard positioning systems, demonstrating the practical risks of location deception in UAV operations.
